assumptions.choice: cost_basis is tracked as a state variable, initialized to initial_investment and halved after each sale, but is not used to gate or size trades
assumptions.reason: spec states sell thresholds are tied only to position market value relative to initial_investment ('no additional filters'), so cost_basis is bookkeeping-only per the literal text

assumptions.choice: if floor(position * 0.5) rounds to 0 shares, skip the sell order and do not advance cost_basis or threshold_n for that bar
assumptions.reason: spec's action sequence (sell, then adjust cost basis, then move to next threshold) presumes an executable sale; a 0-share order is a no-op so the sequence is not considered triggered

assumptions.choice: rely on backtrader's default order execution (next bar's open), not cheat-on-close
assumptions.reason: spec does not specify execution price/timing; entry_price and threshold checks use bar close values per the spec's explicit formulas, independent of actual fill price

assumptions.choice: treat the first call to next() (first bar of the feed) as the entry bar for both the 400-share buy and entry_price capture
assumptions.reason: spec states 'buy on the first available bar'; no warm-up or indicator requires delaying entry

assumptions.choice: no split/dividend/tax adjustments applied; raw feed OHLCV used as-is
assumptions.reason: spec explicitly states corporate actions are not taken into account, and the harness provides a single unadjusted-or-as-given price series with no separate corporate-action data
